data.detailed_description:
UPDATE COMING SOON

Hello everyone,

We apologize for the long silence but in the coming months we will have a major update and announcement as we have relaunched the game. Stay tuned for upcoming information, we thank everyone for their patience and hope to surprise everyone with the new progress the team has made. Thank you!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: OS: Windows 10 (64bit version only)
  • Processor: CPU: Intel® Core™ i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen™ 5 2500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce® GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon™ R9 390X (or equivalent with 4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 30 GB (SSD recommended) GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: Headphones recommended
